using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class FailoverSessionTests
    {
        // We will test the logging of LogWarning on the awaited Task.WhenAll call in the method that calls BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync.
        // Since the method is private and partial class, we will test the behavior by invoking the public method BeginAsyncReplicaFailoverAsync
        // which internally calls the private method that contains the LogWarning call on line 276.
        // We will mock the ILogger to verify that LogWarning is called when an exception is thrown from the awaited tasks.

        [Fact]
        public async Task BeginAsyncReplicaFailoverAsync_LogsWarningWhenAttachReplicaTasksThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var failoverSession = new TestableFailoverSession(loggerMock.Object);

            // Setup the BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync to throw an exception to simulate failure in attachReplicaTasks
            failoverSession.SetupBroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsyncToThrow = true;

            // Act
            var result = await failoverSession.InvokeBeginAsyncReplicaFailoverAsync();

            // Assert
            // The method should catch the exception and log a warning
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("WaitingForAttachToComplete Error")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            // The result should be false because the failover should fail due to the exception
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        // Helper subclass to expose private methods and inject logger
        private class TestableFailoverSession : FailoverSession
        {
            private readonly ILogger _logger;
            public bool SetupBroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsyncToThrow { get; set; }

            public TestableFailoverSession(ILogger logger)
            {
                _logger = logger;
                base.logger = logger;
                // Setup other required fields or mocks if needed
                // For simplicity, we will override BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync to throw if flag is set
            }

            public async Task<bool> InvokeBeginAsyncReplicaFailoverAsync()
            {
                return await base.BeginAsyncReplicaFailoverAsync();
            }

            // Override BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync to simulate throwing exception
            private new async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(string replicaId, byte[] configByteArray)
            {
                if (SetupBroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsyncToThrow)
                {
                    await Task.Yield();
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated attach failure");
                }
                await Task.CompletedTask;
            }
        }
    }
}
